# @mgpl-diagnostics/tally-kit

> The MGPL Diagnostics accounting engine (in development): account groups, ledgers, vouchers, double-entry posting, and books reports (trial balance, ledger statement, day book, cash/bank books, P&L, balance sheet). A library on db-kit's repositories (MongoDB or PostgreSQL, ACID, integer paise). It implements db-kit's PostingHook and serves finance-kit. Our own software, Tally-like in concepts only, with no Tally import or export.

Key facts for agents:
- Status: scaffolded, no code yet. Scope, migration plan and rules are in AGENTS.md.
- Peer dependency: @mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit (>= 1.1.0, which has PostingHook and periodLocks).
- Behaviour must match db-kit's current accounting.ts / reports.ts exactly before replacing them.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it will do
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): scope, migration plan, rules
